subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Amusing
solution:
The correct answer is: **Laughable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amusing** means causing laughter and providing entertainment.

 
 
• **Example -** *He's one of the most **amusing** people I know.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Laughable** means so ludicrous as to be amusing.
 
 
• **Example -** *Look at it enough and it's actually quite **laughable**, rather than lamentable.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Amusing'** and** 'Laughable'** are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tiresome** means causing one to feel bored or annoyed.
 
• **Dull** means lacking interest or excitement.
 
• **Wise** means having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgement.
